name: Staten Island Mall
summary: Large indoor mall featuring a variety of stores, plus eateries, a mall-walking program & free Wi-Fi.
demographics: Staten Island Mall primarily serves middle to upper-middle income households from Staten Island and neighboring areas of Brooklyn and New Jersey, with a diverse visitor base reflecting the borough's multicultural population. The trade area encompasses family-oriented shoppers ranging from young professionals to established families, with household incomes typically between $60,000 and $120,000 annually. Shoppers are drawn to the mall's convenient location along Richmond Avenue and its mix of value-oriented and mid-tier retailers that appeal to budget-conscious yet brand-aware consumers. The center attracts a balanced demographic across age groups, from teenagers seeking fashion trends to older adults shopping for home goods and essentials.
description: Staten Island Mall stands as the premier shopping destination on Staten Island, offering residents and visitors a comprehensive retail experience at 2655 Richmond Avenue. As a Simon Property Group center, this enclosed regional mall features a diverse mix of popular national retailers, specialty boutiques, and dining options that cater to the entire family. The mall has served as a community hub for decades, providing convenient access to fashion, home goods, electronics, and entertainment under one roof. With its climate-controlled environment and ample parking, Staten Island Mall offers a comfortable year-round shopping experience. The center continues to evolve with the changing retail landscape, maintaining its position as the island's primary shopping destination for quality brands and customer service.
